stage1.impression: A clean, competent studio render of a tinted blue acrylic horn speaker on a pale blue sweep; the horn's resin glows convincingly but the cabinet reads as a dark navy box, the driver is a black hole with a pasted-looking white oval beside it, and the cloth disc reads as flat matte plastic. The sweep breaks into a visible hard horizon on the right, the floor is a dull grey darker than the wall, and the speaker barely sits on it: no real contact shadow, so it reads as CG rather than a photograph.

blocking_9: Seamless sweep: no visible horizon line where floor meets wall (10-90% transition wider than about 90 px at proof size)
Floor reads as lit paper in the sweep colour (median about 180-200), not dull grey 145
A real contact shadow under the plinth edge, darker than the open floor by 30+ levels, instead of the current brighter rim
Cabinet acrylic reads as translucent Ice blue with light through it, not crushed navy (side panel red channel 3, median lum 37)
Compression driver modelled by light (throat crush under 30%) and no hot disk reflection floating in the horn
Even background tone behind the speaker: left side not a muddy grey (134) against a near-white right (233)
Woofer cover cloth and lining shaders read as fabric and batting (out of scope here, but blocks a 9)

defects.what: Hard horizon on the sweep: wall 237 drops to floor 174 within about 40 px; reads as a table edge, not a curve
Floor underexposed grey (median 147) on a #D3E0E9 sweep; darker than the wall, looks like a separate surface
No contact shadow: floor right under the base is brighter (159) than open floor (147); speaker floats
Left background muddy grey (median 134) while right is near white (233); uneven, dirty-looking backdrop
Cabinet right side crushed to navy (lum 37, R 3): acrylic does not read as translucent Ice
Horn throat / driver 50% crushed to black, a void with no form
Hot white oval (lum 196, 2.5% clipped) left of the driver: a lamp disk mirrored in the horn, reads pasted on
Woofer cover a flat uniform disc (lum range 26), reads as matte plastic, no cloth texture
Mottled denoise/grain texture on the floor, slightly blotchy at crop
Product fills about 75% of the width with only 75 px of floor below: too tight for a narrow colour-card crop and leaves little air

changes.problem: The floor is dull grey and darker than the wall, so the sweep reads as two surfaces and the paper colour is lost.
changes.expected: Front floor rises to about 180-195 in the sweep's pale blue, closer to the wall tone.

changes.problem: The sweep shows a hard horizon on the right where the wall's brightness drops sharply onto the floor.
changes.expected: A long, soft gradient from floor to wall with no visible line; wall settles near 210-222 instead of clipping at 237.

changes.problem: The speaker has no contact shadow; the floor right under the base is brighter than the open floor, so it floats.

evidence.measured: lum_median 159 under the base vs 147 open floor

changes.expected: A soft dark pool under the plinth with a darker core line at the edge, 30+ levels below the open floor after c1.

changes.problem: The camera-side face of the cabinet is crushed to navy, so the Ice acrylic does not read as translucent.
changes.expected: The side panel opens to a readable blue with the batts visible behind it, median about 60-80.

changes.problem: A hot white oval floats in the horn left of the driver: the horn lamp's disk mirrored in the resin, which reads pasted on.

evidence.measured: lum_median 196, clip 2.55%, in an otherwise mid-blue horn (135)

change.from: shape DISK 0.4 x 0.4 m at [1.15, -2.4, 1.25], spread 12
change.to: rectangle 0.9 x 0.25 m at [1.6, -2.0, 1.45], spread 30, irradiance unchanged

changes.expected: The reflection becomes a long soft streak along the horn's flare instead of a round hot spot; no clipping in that area.

changes.problem: The compression driver is a black void with no form, half the throat region crushed.

change.to: power 14 W, area 0.3 x 1.2 m, receivers add the driver body

changes.expected: A clear specular edge traces the driver's dome and phase plug; it stays black but has shape.

changes.problem: The left background is a muddy grey against a near-white right, making the backdrop look dirty and uneven.
changes.expected: Left wall lifts to about 185-215 so the backdrop falls off gently toward the key side rather than going grey.

changes.problem: The product fills about 75% of the frame width with little floor below, too tight for the narrow colour-card crop and leaving no air.

evidence.measured: product spans x 55-460 of 540, base at y 1005 of 1080

changes.expected: Product spans about 62-65% of the width with roughly 12% of floor below the base; all eight colours keep the same framing.
